summary: Live backend regression passed 4/4 and direct API checks returned expected Grade 0 and Grade 2 results. Frontend critical flows could not be retested because the public Expo web preview rendered a blank white page on both / and /upload.

ui_bugs.issue: Public preview renders a blank white page; landing-screen and upload-screen never mount on / or /upload.

action_items: Investigate why the public Expo web bundle mounts a blank document before retesting scan-another node count and export feedback.
After preview mounting is restored, re-run both curated sample UI flows and verify exactly one upload-screen node after Scan another.
Confirm retinaApi.ts and frontend environment use the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; current project exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL instead.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py correctly uses strict os.environ lookups for MONGO_URL and DB_NAME.
Backend tests and live API checks were not mocked; MongoDB persistence and sample prediction endpoints responded successfully.
retinaApi.ts still includes a local sample fallback, which is a MOCKED/FALLBACK path only when the live samples API fails.
Expo logs show a React Native DevTools Electron sandbox warning, but the observed public preview failure is a blank page and needs root-cause investigation.
seed_data_creation: Created live screening records through normal and NPDR sample prediction requests; no seed data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 fixes are present in source: upload testID is focus-gated and export has DOM fallback. This iteration could not validate them because the public Expo preview stayed blank on direct root and upload routes.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open https://retina-dx.preview.emergentagent.com/ or /upload at 375x667, wait 3-4 seconds; body text is empty and relevant testID counts are zero. Supervisor logs previously showed Metro bundling, so inspect current browser/runtime console and Expo route bootstrap before retesting.
